title: Select one PID
prompt: Return all rows whose Id equals target. Example: select_pid([{'Id': 3}], 3) returns that one row.
tests:
assert select_pid([{'Id':3},{'Id':4}],3) == [{'Id':3}], 'Select only exact PID 3'
assert select_pid([],3) == [], 'Missing PID should give an empty list'
solution:
def select_pid(rows, target):
    return [r for r in rows if r.get('Id') == target]

title: Project fields
prompt: Return dictionaries with only Id and ProcessName. Example: CPU should be removed.
tests:
assert project([{'Id':7,'ProcessName':'python','CPU':2}]) == [{'Id':7,'ProcessName':'python'}], 'Keep only the two requested properties'
assert project([]) == [], 'Empty input stays empty'
hint: Build a new dictionary per row.
solution:
def project(rows):
    return [{'Id':r['Id'],'ProcessName':r['ProcessName']} for r in rows]

title: Convert memory
prompt: Return bytes as MiB. Example: 1048576 becomes 1.0.
tests:
assert mib(1048576) == 1.0, '1048576 bytes should be one MiB'
assert mib(0) == 0, 'Zero bytes should stay zero'
assert mib(524288) == 0.5, 'Preserve fractional MiB'

title: Reject reused IDs
prompt: Return True only if Id, start, and run are present in both dictionaries and all equal. Example: same Id but a different start returns False.
tests:
good={'Id':3,'start':'10:00','run':'toy'}
assert same_process(good,good), 'Complete matching identity should pass'
assert not same_process(dict(good,start='11:00'),good), 'Reject a reused ID'
assert not same_process({'Id':3},{'Id':3}), 'Missing identity fields cannot establish ownership'

title: Produce a review record
prompt: Return {'Id': target, 'decision': 'review'} for exactly one matching row with the expected start and run, otherwise None. This only builds data. Example: missing PID gives None.
tests:
rows=[{'Id':8,'start':'a','run':'toy'}]
assert review(rows,8,'a','toy') == {'Id':8,'decision':'review'}, 'Matching identity should produce a review record'
assert review(rows,8,'b','toy') is None, 'Reject changed start time'
assert review(rows,9,'a','toy') is None, 'Reject missing PID'
assert review(rows+rows,8,'a','toy') is None, 'Ambiguous duplicate observations need review outside this function'
hint: First require exactly one matching ID.
